card.name: Small words in crop-growing passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, following, at, from) in farm and crop-science text on pests, seed choice and yield. They come just before a growth stage, timing or variety term.

modes.label: Pest timing phrases
modes.description: Linking word in a sentence on when a crop is vulnerable or when to treat.
modes.example: grain sorghum is most susceptible to corn earworm attack during<< the>> two-week period following pollination.

modes.label: Seed and yield advice
modes.description: Linking word or verb in agronomy advice about varieties, fungicide timing and bushels per acre.
modes.example: applying fungicide at<< the>> R3 growth stage improved yields by

modes.label: Stray other text
modes.description: Occasional small words in unrelated historical or descriptive prose.
modes.example: most Natchez families and communities are found<< in>> Oklahoma
